issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-2945](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-2945)
### Description

After running LST for a few hours, without any fatals or crashes, YugabyteDB sometimes becomes unable to create a new database:
```
yugabyte=# create database foo;
ERROR:  Timed out: Timed out waiting for Create Database
```
This happened after running this:
```
$ cd ~/code/yugabyte-db
$ git checkout 8e03ef6e3d752534d9ebd28e2c2ec3a7bd7109cf
$ ./yb_build.sh release
$ bin/yb-ctl --replication_factor 3 create --tserver_flags=yb_enable_read_committed_isolation=true,ysql_num_shards_per_tserver=1,enable_stream_compression=true,stream_compression_algo=1,yb_num_shards_per_tserver=1 --master_flags=yb_enable_read_committed_isolation=true,enable_stream_compression=true,stream_compression_algo=1,enable_automatic_tablet_splitting=true,tablet_split_low_phase_shard_count_per_node=40,tablet_split_high_phase_shard_count_per_node=50
$ cd ~/code/yb-long-system-test
$ git checkout feb4d1abf2884e7435357b2a20a8cb42945dfd11
$ while true; do python3.9 ./long_system_test.py --nodes=127.0.0.1:5433,127.0.0.2:5433,127.0.0.3:5433 --threads=20 --runtime=10 --max-columns=200 --complexity=average; sleep 60; done
```
One run everything was fine, next run the database creation timed out. So I don't think the LST logs will help much: 
[lst.zip](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/files/9115851/lst.zip)
I'll provide the yugabyte-data directory, but it's 60 GB in size uncompressed, available from within Yugabyte oranization: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xWL_H3yheK6mzQ4pzzz_DCH0H0mx3HyL/view?usp=sharing
Maybe create database just keeps being slower when you have many databases.
